requirement.description: The EIP-712 domain separator calculation is not producing the correct hash values for the test cases. The current implementation doesn't properly handle the data encoding and padding according to EIP-712 specification.
requirement.contract: Given a domain dictionary with name, version, chainId, and verifyingContract fields, the function should compute the correct EIP-712 domain separator hash using keccak256("EIP712Domain(...)" + keccak256(name) + keccak256(version) + chainId + verifyingContract) where chainId and verifyingContract are properly encoded as 32-byte values.

requirement.description: The transaction serialization logic does not properly handle EIP-1559 transaction types. The transaction type detection and field mapping is incorrect, particularly for EIP-1559 transactions which have different field names and structure.
requirement.contract: For EIP-1559 transactions (type 2), the function should properly serialize transaction data with fields: chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list. The serialization should follow RLP encoding rules and properly handle field name mappings.

requirement.description: The text message hashing for personal_sign mode is not correctly implementing the Ethereum signed message prefixing. The message should be prefixed with "\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" followed by the length of the message.
requirement.contract: For personal_sign mode, the function should prefix the message with "\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" + length_of_message + message, then compute the keccak256 hash of the result.

requirement.description: The transaction signing function is not correctly passing the chain_id parameter to the underlying signature creation function, causing signature mismatches in EIP-1559 transactions.
requirement.contract: The sign_transaction function should properly pass the chain_id parameter to the underlying signature creation function to ensure proper V-value calculation for EIP-1559 transactions.

requirement.description: Several functions in the codebase exceed the maximum 2 positional arguments limit. Functions need to be modified to use '*' in function signatures to enforce keyword-only arguments.
requirement.contract: Functions with more than 2 positional arguments should be modified to enforce keyword-only arguments by adding '*' in their signature. This affects functions throughout the codebase that don't follow this convention.
